note: Every document this package is held to, by identity rather than by name. conformance/documents.py brings each one down again and refuses anything whose digest does not match.

authority.1: A manufacturer document. What the maker of the part printed about it.
authority.2: A recording taken off a real part, which is conformance/suites.json rather than a document, so nothing in this folder occupies that rung.
authority.3: Independent research, for what no manufacturer printed.

whyNotCarriedHere: These are the publishers' documents, not this project's, and this repository is public. What is carried is the identity, which is what makes a copy checkable.

documents.title: uPD77C25/uPD77P25 Digital Signal Processor Data Sheet, Advance Product Information
documents.settles: The instruction set, the register file, the memory sizes and the pin functions. It covers the mask-ROM part and the UVEPROM part, which it describes as functionally identical.

documents.title: Digital Signal Processor (DSP) and Speech Processor Products Data Book, document 50052
documents.settles: The wider family the part belongs to, and the second witness for figures the data sheet prints once.
